Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Dallas hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 12 of the 15 Dallas hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 3, Billabook.com at 2, Super.com at 2, trivago DEALS at 2, Vio.com at 2 and Evendo at 1. These are the Dallas rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 13 of the 15 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 3, trivago DEALS at 3, Billabook.com at 2, goseek.com at 2, Super.com at 2, Vio.com at 2, Etrip.net at 1 and Evendo at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 2, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Dallas hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 17% ($22 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 14% at La Quinta Inn & Suites by Wyndham Dallas - Wylie to 18% at Crowne Plaza Dallas Market Ctr - Love Field by IHG. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
